sign_in_words._what: The words an account starts with: every word its sign-in pages, ways and operations say (its words row, src/account/sign_in/words_row.rs; drawn by src/account/sign_in/pages.rs). No word is written in code.

ways._what: Every word of the ways to sign in besides passkeys (src/account/sign_in/way_pages.rs, ways.rs). `rows` has each way's own words by its name in the account's ways row `rows`; `fields` names every input a way's page asks for; `names_refused` says what a name of each kind must look like; `messages` are the words a sent code goes out in, by purpose. `{name}`, `{code}`, `{minutes}`, `{digits}`, `{count}`, `{left}` and `{way}` are filled in; nothing else is.

password.label: Password
password.about: Sign in with your email and a password.
password.removed: Your password is removed. Sign in with a passkey or a code from now on.
password.wrong: That email and password don't match. Try again, or choose Forgot password.

email-code.label: Email code
email-code.about: Get a 6-digit code by email when your passkey is not on the device you are using.
email-code.sign_in_body: We'll email you a {digits}-digit code. It works once, for {minutes} minutes.
email-code.add_title: Add an email for sign-in codes
email-code.added: Added. You can now sign in with a code sent to {name}.
email-code.removed: Your sign-in email is removed. Codes are no longer sent to it.
email-code.wrong: That code is not right, or it has ended. Check the newest email, or send a new code.

text-code.label: Text code
text-code.about: Get a 6-digit code by text. Signing in this way also asks for your password, so a number given to someone else cannot open your account.
text-code.sign_in_body: Use the phone you verified on Account & security. You will also need your password. Text messages may cost your carrier’s usual rate.
text-code.add_title: Add a phone for sign-in codes
text-code.added: Added. You can now sign in with a code sent to {name} and your password.
text-code.removed: Your sign-in phone is removed. Codes are no longer sent to it.
text-code.wrong: That code or password is not right, or the code has ended. Check the newest text, or send a new code.

authenticator.label: Authenticator app
authenticator.about: Sign in with the code your authenticator app shows for this account.
authenticator.sign_in_title: Sign in with your authenticator app
authenticator.added: Your authenticator app is on. It shows a new code every 30 seconds.
authenticator.changed: Your new authenticator app is on. The old one's codes no longer sign in.
authenticator.removed: Your authenticator app is removed. Its codes no longer sign in.
authenticator.wrong: That code is not right. Type the newest code your authenticator app shows for this account.

backup-codes.label: Backup codes
backup-codes.about: One-time codes you keep for when every device is lost.
backup-codes.sign_in_title: Sign in with a backup code
backup-codes.added: Keep these somewhere safe, away from this device. Each works once.
backup-codes.changed: Keep these somewhere safe, away from this device. Each works once. Your older codes no longer work.
backup-codes.wrong: That backup code is not right, or it was already used. Check it, or try another way to sign in.

personal-key.label: Personal key
personal-key.about: Connect an AI app with a personal key instead of a passkey.
personal-key.added: Copy this key now: it is shown only this once. Anyone holding it can use your account until you turn it off.
personal-key.changed: Copy this key now: it is shown only this once.
personal-key.removed: That personal key is turned off.
personal-key.wrong: That personal key is not valid. Check it, or sign in with a passkey.

names_refused.email: Type the email address you sign in with.
names_refused.phone: Type the phone number with its country code, such as +1 555-0100.

sign_in.subject: Your sign-in code: {code}

confirm.subject: Your code to add this address: {code}

ways.code_sent: If this email has a Trillion account, a {digits}-digit code is on its way. It works for {minutes} minutes. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
ways.confirm_sent: A {digits}-digit code is on its way to {name}. It works for {minutes} minutes.
ways.not_sent: The code could not be sent just now, so none is on its way. Try again in a minute.
ways.delivery_unknown: We could not confirm whether a code was sent. If it arrives, try it here. Asking again will not send another code until the current one expires.

add_email.title: Add your email
add_email.body: So any device can sign in with a code we email you. The code works once, for {minutes} minutes.

ways.too_many: Too many tries. Wait {minutes} minutes, then try again.
ways.current_wrong: Your current password is not right. Type it again, or choose Forgot password.
ways.setup_ended: This setup ended. Open it again from Sign-in & security.
ways.needs_first: Add {way} first: signing in this way needs it too.
ways.needed_by: Remove {way} first: it needs this way.
ways.last_way_in: This is your only way to sign in. Add a passkey or another way first, then remove it.
ways.sign_in_again: For your safety, sign in again first.
ways.not_this_session: A sign-in this way cannot change your ways to sign in. Sign in another way first.
ways.no_request: Open this from the app you are connecting.
ways.listed_left: Signed in. You have {left} backup codes left.
ways.listed_last: Signed in. That was your last backup code: make new ones on Sign-in & security.
ways.timed_scan: Scan this with your authenticator app, or type the key below into it. Then type the code it shows.
ways.timed_picture: A QR code for your authenticator app
ways.passkey_add_here: Add a passkey on this device
ways.passkey_link_button: Add a passkey on another device
ways.passkey_link_reveal: Open this link on the other device within {minutes} minutes. It adds one passkey there, then stops working.
ways.waiting_count: {count} passkey links, sign-ins or codes are waiting to be used.

sign_in_words.connect_body: {client} will be able to use your Trillion records and tools. You can disconnect it at any time.
sign_in_words.add_passkey_body: Choose a name for this passkey so you can find it in your password manager. This link works once.
sign_in_words.add_passkey_body_signed_in: Choose a name for this passkey so you can find it in your password manager.
sign_in_words.offer_passkey_title: Make a passkey on this device
sign_in_words.offer_passkey_body: You signed in with a code. A passkey on this device signs you in next time without one.
sign_in_words.offer_passkey_button: Make a passkey on this device
sign_in_words.failed: That did not work. Try again.
sign_in_words.no_passkey: This browser has no passkey for Trillion yet. Ask the Trillion app for a passkey link, or ask an AI that holds your sign-in key.
sign_in_words.refused: This sign-in request is not valid. Go back to the app and try again.
sign_in_words.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
sign_in_words.sign_up_body: If your setup requires access to a beta app, Trillion may arrange its invitation through the app provider using your verified account email. Trillion HQ sees what you do here, like which screens you open, which tools run and any errors, so we can fix things for you. We never see what you write unless you allow it. You can change this any time in Settings, under Privacy.
sign_in_words.sign_up_done: Your account is ready. Its address is {address}. Keep it: AI apps use it to find your account.
sign_in_words.sign_up_closed: The computer behind this page is not taking new accounts. Ask whoever runs the computer that keeps your account, or sign up on another computer.

sign_up_form.code_body: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
sign_up_form.name_required: Enter your first and last name.
sign_up_form.code_unavailable: Email codes are not set up on this computer yet.
sign_up_form.code_unsent: We could not send the code. Try again in a moment.
sign_up_form.code_limited: Too many codes were sent to this address. Try again later.
sign_up_form.code_failed: That code is not right. Try again.
sign_up_form.email_taken: Another account already uses this email. Sign in to that account, or use another email.
sign_up_form.closed_full: This computer is not taking new accounts right now. Try again later.

set_password.meta_description: Set the password for your Trillion account.
set_password.set_body: Sign in with {email} and a password on any device.
set_password.strength_fine: Fine. A longer password is stronger.
set_password.not_the_same: The two new passwords are not the same. Type it again.

approve.title: Approve this change
approve.body: {tool} asks to use {capability} on this computer. Check what it would hold, then confirm with your passkey. Nothing changes until you do.
approve.failed: That did not go through. Nothing was changed.
approve.gone: This offer is not here any more. Ask for a new one.
approve.no_passkey: This account has no passkey that can confirm this.

page.meta_description: Sign in to Trillion or create your account, and bring the AI you already use to find the needle mover and get it done.

operations._what: Words the sign-in's own operations answer with (src/account/account_routes.rs, src/account/sign_in/calls.rs, known.rs). `{limit}`, `{seconds}`, `{from}`, `{count}`, `{words}` and, in `confirm_words`, a change's own fields (`{way}`) are filled in; nothing else is. `confirm_words` names every change a known passkey's confirmation may be for (src/account/sign_in/known.rs `Change`).
operations.too_many_calls: This sign-in made more than {limit} calls in {seconds} seconds. Wait a minute, or ask for several things in one call.
operations.not_known_yet: This passkey cannot confirm this change until {from}: it was added without a confirmation from a passkey you already had. Use a passkey you had before, or wait until then.
operations.never_known: This passkey signs in, but it was added without a confirmation from a passkey you already had, so it cannot confirm changes. Vouch for it with a passkey you had before.
operations.needs_known_passkey: This change needs your passkey: confirm it with a passkey you already had.
operations.held_while_waiting: A new passkey or a passkey recovery is waiting, so the ways you sign in and are told cannot change now. Remove the waiting passkey, cancel the recovery, or sign in with a passkey you had before, which cancels it.
operations.too_many_notices: Too many passkeys were added or recoveries asked for on this account today. Try again tomorrow.
operations.added_title: A new passkey was added to your Trillion account
operations.added_body: It signs in now. From {from} it can also confirm changes. If you did not add it, remove it before then, or sign in with a passkey you had before; either cancels it.
operations.added_vouched_body: It signs in now. A passkey you already had confirmed it, so from {from} it can also confirm changes. If you did not do this, remove it before then.
operations.added_unvouched_body: It signs in, but it cannot confirm changes, since no passkey you had confirmed it. If you did not add it, remove it.
operations.recovery_title: Someone asked to recover the passkeys on your Trillion account
operations.recovery_body: From {from} the passkeys you have now stop confirming changes. If you did not ask for this, sign in with one of them before then; that cancels it.
operations.recovery_started: Recovery started. From {from} your old passkeys stop confirming changes, and a passkey you add now can confirm them from then.
operations.recovery_not_needed: Your account has no passkey that confirms changes now, so a passkey you add waits out its notice without a recovery.
operations.vouched: This passkey can confirm changes from {from}. You are told of it now.
operations.already_known: This passkey can already confirm changes.
operations.not_a_change: That is not a change a passkey confirms here.
operations.confirmed_title: Your passkey confirmed a change on your Trillion account
operations.confirmed_body: {words} If you did not do this, sign in with your passkey and undo it: a passkey added this way waits before it counts.
operations.legacy_unvouched_body: Passkeys on your account saved before Trillion recorded how each was added ({count}) still sign you in, but they confirm changes only once a passkey that already confirms changes vouches for them.
operations.legacy_waits_body: Passkeys on your account saved before Trillion recorded how each was added ({count}) still sign you in, and from {from} they can confirm changes. If you do not recognize one, remove it before then.
operations.delayed_title: Someone asked to delete your Trillion account
operations.delayed_body: It goes ahead only if it is asked again after {from}. If you did not ask for this, sign in with a passkey you had before, or cancel it; either ends it.
operations.delayed_started: This waits until {from}, and you are told of it now. Ask again after then to go ahead.
operations.delayed_waiting: This waits until {from}. Ask again after then to go ahead.
operations.delayed_other: Another change that deletes your account is waiting until {from}. Cancel it first, or wait.

confirm_words.vouch-passkey: Confirm with your passkey: let another of your passkeys confirm changes once its notice has passed.
confirm_words.remove-passkey: Confirm with your passkey: remove a passkey that confirms changes.
confirm_words.remove-way: Confirm with your passkey: remove a way you sign in ({way}).
confirm_words.replace-way: Confirm with your passkey: change a way you sign in ({way}).
confirm_words.end-session: Confirm with your passkey: sign out another browser.
confirm_words.delete-account: Confirm with your passkey: delete your Trillion account and everything in it.
